title: APT Agent Standards Distribution Contract
source: Governance contract between apt-principles-agents and apt-principles-agents

apt-principles-agents.role: agent harness implementation, standards installer, and cross-tool distribution system
owns: Claude, Codex, and GitHub Copilot distribution surfaces

rules: managedFiles records target-repo files controlled by apt-principles-agents
managedFileSources records source files used to update target-native files
localContext points to target-owned project context and must be preserved during sync
first-run installs create missing managed files and a local context starter without overwriting existing files unless force is explicit
update runs use sync and update only managed files unless an operator explicitly forces recreation
profiles are composable capabilities, not repo types
profile files list source files to install or sync
profile additions must preserve deterministic dry-run behavior
source folders stay reviewable in apt-principles-agents
installer maps source folders into tool-native target paths
tool-native target files should not become the canonical doctrine source
high-value workflows should maintain cross-tool parity where practical
harness docs and scripts reference apt-principles-agents standards instead of redefining them
model registry entries are implementation configuration, not doctrine
lifecycle reports are implementation evidence, not canonical standards

governance_rules: Do not merge apt-principles-agents installer, profile, or path-mapping behavior into apt-principles-agents.
Do not merge apt-principles-agents harness agents, routing registries, context packs, lifecycle scripts, or runtime reports into apt-principles-agents.
Update apt-principles-agents first when doctrine, review criteria, or APT lifecycle rules change.
Update apt-principles-agents when harness implementation, installed agent files, profile composition, lifecycle tooling, or tool-specific distribution behavior must change.
Use dry-run install and sync before applying standards to a real target repository.
Use curated profile selections when auto-detection signals are advisory or noisy.
Reusable doctrine improvements discovered through apt-principles-agents should flow back into apt-principles-agents.
